title: fedi-e2ee HKDF uses None salt
description: derive_encryption_key() at fedi-e2ee/src/lib.rs:178 passes None as the HKDF salt: Hkdf::<Sha256>::new(None, shared_secret). RFC 5869 allows this but recommends a salt for stronger extraction. The info string 'fedi-e2ee-xchacha20-v1' provides domain separation, and X25519 DH output has good entropy, so this is not exploitable. Best practice: use a fixed public salt string (e.g. b'fedi-e2ee-v1-salt') to strengthen the extract step per the HKDF security proof.
close_reason: Accepted: HKDF security proof is weaker with None salt but not exploitable here. Shared secret comes from X25519 DH with full entropy. Info-string domain separation (fedi-e2ee-xchacha20-v1) prevents cross-protocol attacks. Adding a salt would change the wire format.
